name: Osananajimi to Watashi to Game no Hanashi
original_name: 幼なじみと私とゲームの話
source:
My childhood friend handed me a game.
Even though he was always all talk, he shyly said, "I worked hard on it."
Just as I was about to take it, I realised. But, isn't there a test tomorrow!? What bad timing!
Should I prioritise my childhood friend's feelings first and accept it, or should I put my test first.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16543]Freem![/url]]
translation:
青梅竹马递给我一款游戏。
平时总是光说不练的他，这回却害羞地说，“我很用心做的。”
正要接过来时，我忽然想起，明天不是还有考试吗！？这时机也太糟糕了！
我是该先顾及青梅竹马的心意，收下游戏，还是把考试放在第一位呢？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16543]Freem![/url]]
